classification.07: suffix-only non-pair resolution beginning at resolution_first
classification.08: suffix-only pair resolution closing at resolution_count

range_rule.boot: Before READY, image_first is zero and the authenticated immutable Shelf domain may be read in full.
range_rule.append: After READY, only c2_decode_active == &c2aw.append may use c2_stream_shelf_read, every address must carry C2_SESSION_SOURCE_TAG, and the untagged span must lie wholly inside [c2aw.attic, c2aw.attic + c2aw.length).
range_rule.hot: No resumable execution consumer may call c2_stream_shelf_read after READY.
range_rule.failure: A wrong domain, missing tag, lower-bound underflow, end overflow or absent active append context fails before starting DMA.

cold_enforcement.producer: The staged Append transaction is the sole authority for its private source domain: c2aw.attic and c2aw.length are authenticated before c2aw.append is finalized, and no second seal is materialized in the decoder context.
cold_enforcement.barrier: c2_append_source_domain_guard is a named noinline member of Session overlay phase 04. Before READY it admits only image_first zero; after READY it requires c2_decode_active == &c2aw.append, a staged nonempty transaction and a nonwrapping span wholly inside the Session bank before the first source read.
cold_enforcement.closure: The serial decoder enters post-READY decoding only at phase 04; phases 05a, 05b, 06a, 06b, 07 and 08 are reachable only after the phase-04 barrier, and source-consuming publication is reachable only after decoder finished.
cold_enforcement.consumer_dataflow: Suffix image rows are Session-kind records produced before phase 04; their tagged code/metadata coordinates derive directly from the same active transaction and all validated subordinate intervals remain inside its private span.
cold_enforcement.handoff: Phase 04 consumes the existing transaction scratch directly. No new marker, pointer, state byte or alternate context identity crosses the load boundary; shelf_bytes and c2d_bytes remain canonical throughout.
cold_enforcement.resident_seam: c2_stream_shelf_read remains byteidentical to Link 54; it performs transport only after the cold closure has authorized the Session source domain.

boot_full_staging.rule: All four phases visit every image from zero through image_count-1.

append_suffix.rule: All four phases visit exactly image_first through image_count-1 and never inspect a prefix image.

next_gate: One product-shaped WPLTO probe; if and only if every wall and closure gate is green, build product Link 55. Hardware remains a later gate.
